private ContractReqDTO buildContractSubmitReq(Contract contract) {
		ContractUser legalUser = contractUserService.getLatestUserByRole(contract.getContractCode(), RoleTypeEnum.LEGAL.getCode());
		ContractUser companyAgentUser = contractUserService.getLatestUserByRole(contract.getContractCode(), RoleTypeEnum.COMPANY_AGENT.getCode());
		Map<String, String> contractFieldMap = contractFieldService.getFieldMap(contract.getContractCode());

		return ContractReqDTO.builder()
			.contractBaseInfo(ContractBaseInfoReq.builder()
				.projectOrderId(contract.getProjectOrderId())
				.contractType(ContractTypeEnum.ACCREDIT.getCode())
				.submitCompanyCode(contract.getCompanyCode())
				.build())
			.signInfo(ContractSignInfoReq.builder()
				.contractObjectType(ContractObjectTypeEnum.COMPANY.getCode())
				.signChannelType(SignChannelTypeEnum.ONLINE.getCode())
				.userSignType(UserSignTypeEnum.SIGN.getCode())
				.companyName(contractFieldMap.get("companyName"))
				.companyCreditCode(contractFieldMap.get("companyCreditCode"))
				.registeredAddress(contractFieldMap.get("registeredAddress"))
				.signCompanyCode(contract.getCompanyCode())
				.signRole(RoleTypeEnum.LEGAL.getCode())
				.legalName(legalUser.getName())
				.legalPhone(legalUser.getPhone())
				.legalCertificateType(legalUser.getCertificateType())
				.legalCertificateNo(legalUser.getCertificateNo())
				.companyAgentName(Optional.ofNullable(companyAgentUser).map(ContractUser::getName).orElse(null))
				.companyAgentPhone(Optional.ofNullable(companyAgentUser).map(ContractUser::getPhone).orElse(null))
				.companyAgentCertificateType(Optional.ofNullable(companyAgentUser).map(ContractUser::getCertificateType).orElse(null))
				.companyAgentCertificateNo(Optional.ofNullable(companyAgentUser).map(ContractUser::getCertificateNo).orElse(null))
				.build())
			.projectInfo(ContractProjectInfoReq.builder()
				.businessType(contract.getBusinessType())
				.gbCode(Integer.valueOf(contractFieldMap.get("gbCode")))
				.gbName(contractFieldMap.get("gbName"))
				.districtName(contractFieldMap.get("districtName"))
				.resblockName(contractFieldMap.get("resblockName"))
				.buildingName(contractFieldMap.get("buildingName"))
				.unitName(contractFieldMap.get("unitName"))
				.floorName(contractFieldMap.get("floorName"))
				.houseName(contractFieldMap.get("houseName"))
				.build())
			.businessInfo(BusinessInfoDetail.builder()
				.decorateType(contract.getBusinessType().toString())
				.build())
			.build();
	}
